name: Marco Polo
description: Set in a world of greed, betrayal, sexual intrigue and rivalry, this lavish drama series follows explorer Marco Polo's adventures in the 13th century.

videos.title: The Wayfarer
videos.overview: After three years crossing seas, deserts and the Silk Road, a young Marco Polo finds himself a prisoner of the great Kublai Khan.

videos.title: The Wolf and the Deer
videos.overview: As Kublai Khan battles his warmonger brother for rule over Mongolia, Marco learns that justice in Khan's Imperial City is as swift as it is deadly.

videos.title: Feast
videos.overview: Marco begins a dangerous relationship with the beautiful Blue Princess as tensions grow between Kublai and Xiangyang's cunning chancellor Jia Sidao.

videos.title: The Fourth Step
videos.overview: As war looms with the walled city of Xiangyang, Prince Jingim tests his diplomacy skills while Kublai questions Marco's allegiance.

videos.title: Hashshashin
videos.overview: Marco searches for the mastermind behind a murderous plot, while Prince Jingim weighs the risks of retaliation.

videos.title: White Moon
videos.overview: On the eve of an auspicious ceremony, Marco searches for the culprit behind the assassination attempt on Kublai Khan -- even as a new one takes shape.

videos.title: The Scholar's Pen
videos.overview: Marco and Hundred Eyes take on a dangerous mission to infiltrate the walled city of Xiangyang, while its chancellor struggles to hold on to power.

videos.title: Rendering
videos.overview: When Kublai sets his sights -- and his army -- on the taking of the walled city of Xiangyang, Marco's allegiance is tested.

videos.title: Prisoners
videos.overview: Marco finds his fate in the hands of Kublai yet again, while behind the walls of Xiangyang, Chancellor Sidao sets his sights on regaining power.

videos.title: The Heavenly and Primal
videos.overview: Marco's ingenuity -- and loyalty -- is put to the ultimate test when Kublai takes a violent and bold step in his quest to become emperor of the world.

videos.title: Hunter and the Sable Weaver
videos.overview: On Prince Jingim's wedding day, Kublai receives disturbing news about the ambitions of his cousin, while Marco navigates a delicate mission.

videos.title: Hug
videos.overview: Marco gets an unpleasant surprise upon his return to Kublai's court. Kublai faces an impossibly difficult decision.

videos.title: Measure Against the Linchpin
videos.overview: Haunted by recent events, Kublai journeys with Marco into the mountains for answers. Empress Chabi takes action to insure an heir to the khan.

videos.title: Let God's Work Begin
videos.overview: The challenge for the throne escalates when two of Kublai's sons are endangered. Far away, another threat to the khan is born.

videos.title: Lullaby
videos.overview: Rebel attacks flare up in the south and pull Kublai's attention away from home. Kokachin gets an unwelcome visitor from her past.

videos.title: Serpent's Terms
videos.overview: Ahmad's deadly and secret chess match against Kublai enters its endgame, even as Kublai's thirst for power grows stronger than ever.

videos.title: Lost Crane
videos.overview: Kaidu's ruthlessness reaches new levels in his bid for power, while Hundred Eyes' former lover has him questioning his loyalties.

videos.title: Whitehorse
videos.overview: Marco's allegiance to Kublai is tested like never before. Mei Lin's bold move throws Ahmad's plans into chaos.

videos.title: Heirs
videos.overview: Marco's past with Kokachin resurfaces. Kublai's position as khan faces a final challenge, even as he welcomes a new heir into the world.

videos.title: The Fellowship
videos.overview: The day of the kurultai arrives, shaping Kublai's fate as khan. Ahmad makes his final stand, and Marco learns a terrible truth.

language: English, Cantonese, Mandarin, Mongolian, Persian, Italian, Uighur, Arabic
awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 3 wins & 6 nominations total
